spec.name: Carved Linear Wool Rug
spec.proportions: 140 cm W x 200 cm L x 2 cm H
details: High-low pile relief creating a subtle block pattern
Soft, dense 2 cm thick wool construction
Tightly finished self-bound edges on all four sides
spec.studio_prompt: A rectangular wool area rug measuring 140 cm by 200 cm and 2 cm thick. The surface features a soft cut-pile tufted wool in cream (#c0b9b0) detailed with a tonal carved geometric block relief. Recessed linear channels in warm taupe (#aa9b88) define the architectural vertical pattern. The perimeter is neatly finished with tightly whipstitched wool binding (#86684c), lying completely flat with plush, tactile dual-height texture throughout.
